value.condition: Successful source path after awaited Save; the 200 JSON schema is the declared contract. Dashboard must parse the upstream body to forward it.
value.consumer: Dashboard response forwarding; browser HTTP status only
value.coveredScope: Captured Save a city source ranges only; no publisher or forecast consumer expansion
value.unresolved: Declared schema and static mapping only; wire conformance and runtime execution are unverified. Whole-body forwarding is not a named browser field read. A 503 does not establish rollback or safe retry.
